description:
Our client, a national financial leader, is looking for an experienced Database Developer to create and optimize database queries, indexes, stored procedures, triggers, and reports. 
 MUST HAVE SKILLS/EXPERIENCE 

 Multiple years of experience in database design and development
 Experience with SQL Server 2008+, SQL Server Management Studio and other data management tools
 Extensive experience with SSRS, SSIS, and T-SQL
 Proven experience in designing complex physical and logical data models
 Significant experience in database set-up, maintenance, performance tuning, and partitioning
 SKILLS/EXPERIENCE
 Financial industry experience 
 Self-directed, self-motivated and able to take a concept-to-implementation with a high degree of robustness
 Great communication skills. and a collaborator that performs well in a team-oriented environment
 Ability to make progress in a fast paced, ever changing environment
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Work with application developers to deliver data through the design of stored procedures, functions, and views.
 Design complex physical and logical data models.
 Create database queries, indexes and stored procedures, some with high levels of complexity.
 Review monitoring tools and query execution plans to maintain or increase query efficiency.
 Perform root cause analysis on query performance issues and other database issues.
 Write and create data load scripts and stored procedures.
 Work with application developers in the design, tuning, and indexing of tables.
 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 12+ MONTHS 
 
 Target Start Date: 11/23/2015 
 Target End Date: 5/22/2016 with potential for extension
